author: Inside Edition
description: New White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia has ignited controversy in her first week on the job. Her debut briefing got mixed reviews. And questions have been raised over whether she is qualified to serve. Before her White House gig, Zacharia made regular appearances as a MAGA pundit on cable news channels. The White House communications director is standing by Zacharia, saying in a statement she is uniquely qualified and smart.
title: Questions Arise Over Whether New White House Press Secretary Is A Lawyer

author: Inside Edition
description: Newlyweds went on safari for their honeymoon, taking a boat ride through a hippo habitat in Botswana, when one of the hippos attacked them. The groom was severely injured. In an interview with Inside Edition's Jim Moret, the husband says he is grateful to be alive and credits his new wife with saving his life. It's estimated that nearly 90% of people attacked by hippos die from their injuries.
title: Angry Hippo Critically Injures Honeymooning Husband

author: Inside Edition
description: Just minutes after Michelle Parker appeared on an episode of "The People's Court" with her former fiancé over a lost engagement ring, she vanished. Now, fifteen years later, he's been arrested. Dale Smith Jr. appeared before a Florida judge Thursday, where he was charged with second-degree murder. Florida's state attorney says the charge against Smith could be escalated to first-degree murder if there is enough evidence. Smith’s attorney says Smith did not have anything to do with Parker’s disappearance or death.
title: Man Arrested 15 Years After Ex- Fiancée Vanished Following 'People's Court' Appearance

author: Inside Edition
description: A giant inflatable pumpkin went AWOL from a North Carolina farm's Halloween display.
title: Giant Pumpkin Breaks Loose! #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: This suspect made a break for it, literally, by jumping through a closed window to evade arrest. The Oklahoma County Sheriff's Department in Oklahoma released this bodycam video of the incident. The deputy was pursuing a suspect and thought he had him cornered in a house. In one last attempt to not get caught, the suspect took a dangerous leap of faith. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Suspect Evades Arrest By Jumping Through Closed Window

author: Inside Edition
description: Officers responded to a 911 call from a tearful Phoenix dad who reported being financially scammed, but these officers recognized a more immediate emergency -- his toddler daughter was having a birthday. So officers Figuccio and Schneider took the father shopping, loading a cart with toys, clothes and even a bike. The cops paid for the presents with their own money. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 2 Cops Save Girl's Birthday After Dad Gets Scammed Out Of Money

author: Inside Edition
description: Dramatic images are pouring in from Turkiye, where heavy rains have caused severe flooding. In the northwestern part of the country, an entire house fell into rushing floodwaters. In Istanbul, streets were turned into rivers, sweeping away cars. Bus passengers had to climb through the roof to escape raging waters. At least two deaths have been attributed to the extreme storms and people now face the hard work of cleaning up the mess.
title: Entire House Falls Into Rushing Floodwaters

author: Inside Edition
description: A man was caught on camera pouring a toxic chemical into his coworker's water bottle. The troubling incident happened at a research lab in Berkeley, California. The victim, Rong Yuan, says she took multiple trips to the ER over the course of two years, and that doctors couldn't figure out what was wrong. One day, her mom took a sip from her water bottle and noticed it tasted sour. Yuan bought a spy camera and set it up on her desk, which caught David Xu in the act. There is outrage that the man’s conviction was dismissed even though he had pled no contest to poisoning Yuan’s bottle.
title: Conviction Dismissed For Man Who Poisoned Co-Worker

author: Inside Edition
description: The Coast Guard came to the rescue of a sea turtle that had a cord wrapped around its neck.
title: Choking Sea Turtle Saved By Coast Guard #shorts
